title: hydrangea borealis
intro: Hydrangea borealis, commonly known as Bigleaf Hydrangea, is a type of flowering plant native to eastern Asia. This plant is rich in health benefits, including the ability to reduce inflammation and alleviate symptoms of arthritis due to its anti-inflammatory properties. Hydrangea borealis is also known for its therapeutic actions, such as acting as a diuretic and promoting the removal of excess fluids from the body. The bioactive constituents of Hydrangea borealis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
